why: Story 7.8 / ADR-009, AC5: the file surface covers what a real project actually needed. The project is shaped like gitnebula at the end of its Epic 6 and its contract carries eight of gitnebula's own criterion ids, each of which the client decided with a hand-written observation script: E6-03 and E6-04 with pkg-scripts.mjs, E6-06, E6-17, E6-23, E6-28 and E6-32 with docs-presence.mjs, E6-09 with ui-source-census.mjs. Here the config declares NOTHING that runs -- no gate, no service, no observation, no script -- and every probe is a file probe, so a PASS at exit 0 can only have come from the product reading the tree itself. The tree is built to reproduce the three defects ADR-009 measured in those scripts, so the fixture goes red if the surface repeats any of them. (1) The validator and layout reports live at docs/dev/epic-6/<story>/README.md, two directories deeper than findReport's non-recursive search looked, and a decoy report sits beside them; a surface without ** recursion reports E6-23 and E6-28 missing. (2) The validator report is worded as the real one was -- 'the seam between two validators', 'Widening' -- and matches none of the script's hand-picked patterns; it is found by case-folded literal stems ('validator', 'unchanged', 'future') required to occur in ONE file. (3) The UI spec spells __gitnebula only inside comments -- in all three quote styles -- beside a string whose // is not a comment, and the census counts the BARE name, as the script's /["'`]__gitnebula["'`]/ counted every quote style (a census of the double-quoted spelling alone, this fixture's first draft, passed over t['__gitnebula'] in code, as the supervisor review of PR #89 reproduced); the handle-key test that enforces the convention and the module that defines the constant both spell it legitimately and are excluded by name. A census that counts comments, or either of those files, reports a non-zero count and E6-09 fails. E6-04 also pins its own enumeration: the probe asserts exactly two workspace package manifests, so a package added without a matching probe breaks the criterion rather than escaping it. evidence is exact ['observation'] because a file probe records the observation member (the closed evidence union is not widened), and nothing else in this run records anything.
